name: Secundus
overview: The Scripture introduces Secundus as a Thessalonian Christian who accompanied the Apostle Paul from Corinth on his journey into Asia. Acts 20:4 highlights Secundus among other believers who traveled with Paul, demonstrating the unity and partnership among early Christians in spreading the gospel. This brief mention underscores the commitment of Thessalonian believers like Secundus to support Paul's missionary efforts and the broader work of the church during this critical period.
